subject: Geopolitics
title: The EU as a Geopolitical Actor
description: Learn The EU as a Geopolitical Actor in one minute.

hook.text: The EU has the world's third-largest economy but no real army. It's an economic giant and a military dwarf.

buildup.text: The EU was built for trade and regulation, not war. Its power lies in markets, standards, and economic sanctions.

discovery.text: The Brussels Effect: the EU's regulatory power forces global companies to meet its standards. Rules become leverage.

twist.text: Ukraine exposed the EU's military weakness. Decisions require unanimity — one veto from Hungary blocked key actions.

climax.text: The EU is debating a common defense force. But national sovereignty fights centralized military the way it always has.

punchline.text: Economic power without military muscle is half a hand.

quiz.question: What is the Brussels Effect?
options: EU member states losing sovereignty to Brussels
EU regulations forcing global companies to meet European standards
The EU's ability to print currency independently
